title: Parking Catch-Up Drafts after a Returned Bank Draft: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Terms and Tenant Tool
content:
**Who may approve, and on what.** A tenant whose vehicle, RV or boat parking AutoPay draft on a bank account under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization was returned unpaid for insufficient or uncollected funds may approve on a recorded call a one-time catch-up draft from the same account for that due date, on an authorization in active status. The approval is recorded on the authorization's notice history as a varying-amount notice for the returned parking due date stating the parking catch-up amount.

**When it runs.** A parking catch-up the tenant approves for a stated amount on a recorded call is a single entry authorized for that exact amount, so it is not held for the method's varying-amount notice period and runs on the next banking day.

**Points of judgement.**

- A parking draft declined on a card is not a returned bank-account draft; these terms cover the bank-account return.
- A return for a reason other than insufficient or uncollected funds is outside these terms.
- An authorization that is suspended, cancelled or replaced is not in active status.

## Tenant tool `approve_parking_returned_draft_catchup_8c80cda9`

The tenant, in person, approves a one-time catch-up draft on a vehicle, RV or boat parking AutoPay authorization for a rent due date whose bank-account draft came back unpaid. One call records, on that authorization's notice history, a new notice dated today carrying the due date the catch-up concerns and the exact dollar amount the tenant approves to be drafted from the bank account on file. Nothing else on the authorization or on the parking agreement changes.

The agent unlocks `approve_parking_returned_draft_catchup_8c80cda9` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `autopay_id` | The AutoPay authorization number of the parking authorization the catch-up is drafted under, as shown in the AutoPay authorization lookup |
| `notice_type` | The kind of notice record written, one of `varying_amount_notice` (the record states an amount to be drafted or charged for one due date; the kind this action records), `card_expiry_reminder` (a reminder that the card on file is about to expire, no amount), `draft_failure_notice` (word that a draft for a due date failed, no amount), `suspension_notice` (word that the authorization has been suspended, no amount) |
| `related_due_date` | The rent due date whose returned draft the catch-up concerns, YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time and no time zone |
| `approved_amount` | The catch-up amount the tenant approves, in US dollars as a positive decimal number with exactly 2 decimal places (for example 123.45); stored rounded half-to-even to the cent |

**Return.** A text receipt "Parking catch-up approval <reference> recorded on AutoPay <authorization number>: <amount> USD for due date <due date>, approved <date>.", the reference being the new notice reference beginning with apn_, the amount the stored amount with 2 decimals, the dates written YYYY-MM-DD and the approval date being today. A receipt in this form means the approval is on record; the tenant receives the confirmation reference and can see the approved amount and due date on the notice history.
